title: Policy Composer: visual selector for region + tier with fallback variant preview
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Build an end-to-end, customer-facing Policy Composer UI that lets users declare routing intent across region preference, customer tier routing, and ordered fallback model variants. The composer should provide: a visual region selector (multi-select with weights), tier-based routing blocks (e.g., platinum/gold/silver) where customers can define model priorities per tier, and a preview/simulation pane that validates and shows how an example request would be routed including fallback variant behavior and estimated latency/cost implications. The feature ties into rollouts and automatic fallback policies in the runtime.

Goals:
- Enable customers to author deterministic routing policies without hand-editing JSON.
- Provide real-time validations and a deterministic preview simulator to reduce rollout risk.
- Surface cost/latency tradeoffs for variant selections and region choices.

Non-goals:
- This ticket does not implement runtime enforcement or autoscaling config; it focuses on Console authoring and validation UX, plus preview simulations calling a mock routing engine.
acceptance_criteria: UI: Region selector supports multi-region selection with per-region weight slider and tooltip explaining latency/egress implications
UI: Tier blocks allow ordered list of model variants per tier and per-variant toggle for 'allow-fallback'
Validation: Editor enforces syntactic rules (no circular fallbacks, total weight > 0) and shows inline errors
Preview: Simulator shows step-by-step routing decision for 3 example request profiles and highlights when fallback would occur
Telemetry: Console emits preview-run events to tracing and preview-run success/failure metrics
Export: Editor can export policy JSON compatible with runtime schema and run a dry-check API that returns validation warnings
